name: services/prgroups/descriptor
description: Get information on a given descriptor of primary groups.
brief_description: Get information on a given descriptor of primary groups.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • Primary:

    • id - descriptor ID;

    • name - a LangDict object with the name of the descriptor.

  • Secondary:

    • source - XML representation of the descriptor;

    • assigned_users - list of users that have some groups assigned from this descriptor.

      This field references objects returned by services/users/user method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

    • auto_assigned_users - list of users that have some groups assigned by sql in descriptor.

      This field references objects returned by services/users/user method. See its returns section for possible subfields.
errors: • object_not_found - primary group descriptor could not be found; param_name is equal to descriptor_id.

result_fields.name: name
result_fields.description: a LangDict object with the name of the descriptor

result_fields.name: assigned_users
result_fields.description: list of users that have some groups assigned from this descriptor

result_fields.name: auto_assigned_users
result_fields.description: list of users that have some groups assigned by sql in descriptor
